en.title: The Rings of Power Officially Confirms Season 4, Filming Set for Spring
en.summary: Amazon has officially announced a fourth season for **The Lord of the Rings: The Rings of Power**, confirming its return amidst the ongoing release of its third season. Pre-production is already underway in the UK, with filming scheduled to begin this spring.
en.body:
The epic saga of Middle-earth's Second Age is set to continue. Amazon has officially bestowed upon fans the news that **The Lord of the Rings: The Rings of Power** has been greenlit for a fourth season. This announcement arrives as the final two episodes of the current third season begin streaming on Prime Video, bringing viewers to the pivotal moment of Sauron forging the One Ring. For those concerned that the Dark Lord's reign might conclude before its full depiction, this confirmation ensures that the unfolding events of the Second Age will receive further exploration.

The production has already shifted its base from New Zealand to the UK, where pre-production for the upcoming season is currently in full swing. Filming is slated to commence this spring, signaling a robust commitment from Amazon MGM Studios to the sprawling fantasy series. Peter Friedlander, Head of Global Television for Amazon MGM Studios, expressed his enthusiasm, stating, "**The Lord of the Rings: The Rings of Power** has become a defining series for Prime Video. As season three delivers the landmark moment fans have been waiting for—the forging of the One Ring—we are proud to confirm season four with [showrunners] J.D. Payne, Patrick McKay, and the entire creative team. We look forward to bringing fans even deeper into the world."

## A Deep Dive into the Second Age

The confirmation of a fourth season comes as a significant development, especially given the staggered release schedule and the intricate plotting required to adapt J.R.R. Tolkien's vast lore. While the exact release date for season four remains unannounced, the early commencement of pre-production and filming suggests a desire to maintain momentum. Showrunners J.D. Payne and Patrick McKay have been actively involved in the writing process for the subsequent season, reportedly working on it concurrently with the post-production of the third season. This simultaneous development indicates a clear vision and a determined pace for the ambitious project.

## What This Means for the Fellowship

This news will undoubtedly energize the passionate global fanbase of **The Lord of the Rings**. The series has been lauded for its visual spectacle and its attempts to flesh out the foundational myths of Tolkien's world. With the forging of the One Ring now imminent in the narrative, the stakes for all the inhabitants of Middle-earth are about to skyrocket. The confirmation of season four allows fans to anticipate further exploration of character arcs, the rise of new threats, and the gradual descent into the darkness that will define the coming ages.

## What's Next

With pre-production underway in the UK and filming set to begin this spring, details regarding the cast and specific plot points for season four are expected to emerge over the coming months. Fans will be eagerly watching for any updates as the journey through the Second Age continues its epic unfolding on Prime Video.

In them, we see Sauron forging the One Ring, which means that the beginning of the end of Middle-earth’s Second Age is nigh. For those worried that Rings of Power might not get a fourth season to portray how things play out for the Dark Lord, don’t fret: Today, Amazon bestowed upon us the news that there will be a fourth season. The upcoming episodes are currently in pre-production in the UK (the show moved there from New Zealand after the first season) and will begin filming this spring. No news yet on when that means we’ll see season four on Prime Video, but fingers crossed it will be less than the two-and-a-half-year pause between seasons two and three. “ The Lord of the Rings: The Rings of Power has become a defining series for Prime Video,” Peter Friedlander, Head of Global Television for Amazon MGM Studios, said in a statement. “As season three delivers the landmark moment fans have been waiting for—the forging of the One Ring—we are proud to confirm season four with [showrunners] J.D. Payne, Patrick McKay, and the entire creative team. We look forward to bringing fans even deeper into the rich world of Tolkien’s Second Age.” That quote confirms that Payne and McKay will remain on as showrunners and will be overseeing the show as it careens toward the epic battle that marks the end of the Second Age. Whether we’ll get to that final showdown in season four remains to be seen. In the meantime, we can watch the first three seasons of The Lord of the Rings: The Rings of Power on Prime Video, and also take a gander at this vertical video announcing the confirmation of a fourth season.
